name: Clementi & West Coast
summary: University-west practicality, park connectors, and better family value than core central.
body: Clementi and West Coast attract households trading central prestige for space and rent relief while staying west of town near NUS and parks. Hawker centres, malls, and MRT coverage make daily life straightforward. International-school runs may still mean driving toward Bukit Timah or Dover. A strong living-mode neighbourhood once the first-month chaos settles.
housingMix: Condos, HDB (eligible), some landed toward West Coast.
commuteNotes: East-West Line (Clementi); Circle Line connections via Buona Vista.
